text: There is a sense of quiet anticipation here—the glass room ready for minds to fill it, the bags waiting like silent witnesses. I feel the potential for discourse and learning, but also a strange emptiness. In the hallway, the museum-like display of R+D surrounds me with vibrant patterns and promises of innovation, sparking curiosity within. Here, the world feels both constructed and open, inviting contemplation of human progress and our ever-changing spaces.
